data.title: 藤原千花 · 烟花祭散场后的紧紧抓住
data.description: 在人海如潮的夏夜花火大会走散后，少年终于在神社鸟居旁的石灯笼下找到了眼眶泛红的千花。看到熟悉身影的瞬间，千花立刻扑上前去，紧紧攥住少年的衣袖不肯松手。烟花在她身后次第盛放，她吸了吸小鼻子，眼里满是委屈又庆幸的泪花。
data.action: clutching sleeve tightly, teary eyes, fireworks blooming behind
data.lighting: explosions of colorful fireworks illuminating tears
data.promptProse: Found under a stone lantern pathway as fireworks boom overhead, Fujiwara Chika clutches the viewer's sleeve tightly with both hands. Tears sparkle in her blue eyes after being separated in the festival crowd, her black bow fluttering in the festive breeze.
data.animaCaption: Chika crying happy tears clutching a sleeve under fireworks.
